estimates.name: Business combinations
estimates.t: Accounting for business combinations requires management to make significant estimates and assumptions, especially at the acquisition date, including estimates for property and equipment and contingent consideration, where applicable.

estimates.name: Rockdale PPA and Corsicana PPA Valuations
estimates.t: The Rockdale PPA and the Corsicana PPA are accounted for as derivatives, the valuations of which are based on significant unobservable inputs, which include discounted cash flow estimation models containing quoted commodity exchange spot and forward prices and are adjusted for basis spreads for load…

estimates.name: Long-Lived Assets
estimates.t: Long-lived assets are stated at cost and depreciated using the straight-line method over the estimated useful lives of the assets.

estimates.name: Stock-Based Compensation
estimates.t: Stock-based compensation expense related to share-based payment awards is measured at the grant date of the award and is estimated based on the fair market value of our common stock on the date of the grant.
